economy.summary: Smucker attributes inflation to high federal spending and says limited government and lower taxes will let families keep more of their paychecks. He supports regulatory relief for small businesses to help them expand and create jobs.
economy.short: Says lower taxes, less spending and regulation help families, businesses.

taxes.summary: Smucker voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (H.R. 1, 2025), describing it as tax relief for working families. His campaign says the national debt exceeds $30 trillion and calls for reining in federal spending.
taxes.short: Voted for 2025 tax bill; calls for reining in spending.

abortion.summary: Smucker's campaign states he has a 100% pro-life voting record and that he welcomed the Supreme Court's decision overturning Roe v. Wade.
abortion.short: States 100% pro-life record; welcomed Roe v. Wade overturn.

education.summary: Smucker supports parental choice in education and emphasizes empowering parents rather than standardized approaches. He also supports investing in technical and career education.
education.short: Supports parental choice in education and investing in technical education.

healthcare.summary: Smucker voted for the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which added work or community-engagement requirements for able-bodied Medicaid recipients without dependents. He says the bill makes no changes to Medicaid coverage for people with disabilities or seniors and includes funds for rural hospitals.
healthcare.short: Voted for Medicaid work requirements; says disabled, seniors keep coverage.

energy.summary: Smucker supports increasing domestic oil and gas production and cutting regulations on energy development. He says renewable energy should also be pursued, with decisions driven by the free market rather than government.
energy.short: Supports more domestic oil, gas production; market-driven renewable energy.

guns.summary: Smucker's campaign says he defends Second Amendment rights, stating that the rights of law-abiding citizens cannot be allowed to be taken away.
guns.short: Defends Second Amendment rights of law-abiding citizens against restrictions.

economy.summary: Mannion supports raising the federal minimum wage, eliminating the Trump administration's broad tariffs to reduce everyday costs, expanding the child tax credit, and building affordable housing.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, ending broad tariffs, expanding child credit.

taxes.summary: Mannion proposes addressing the federal deficit by reviewing spending and closing tax loopholes that benefit wealthy people and large companies. She supports rolling back the 2025 corporate tax rate reductions and increasing IRS funding for audits and services.
taxes.short: Proposes closing tax loopholes, rolling back 2025 corporate tax cuts.

abortion.summary: Mannion says reproductive decisions should be made only between the patient, their family, and a medical provider, and opposes government intrusion in those decisions while respecting those who hold opposing views.
abortion.short: Says reproductive decisions belong to patient, family, and provider.

education.summary: Mannion supports well-funded public schools with better teacher pay, universal free school breakfast and lunch, and mental health support in schools. She opposes tax credits or vouchers for private schools.
education.short: Supports funded public schools, free meals; opposes private-school vouchers.

healthcare.summary: Mannion, a registered nurse, supports affordable healthcare for all, lower prescription medication costs, and healthcare coverage for all children. She proposes reversing budget cuts and restoring public health funding.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable healthcare for all, lower prescription drug costs.

guns.summary: Mannion supports stronger gun laws and more mental health support in schools as part of her student-safety priorities.
guns.short: Supports stronger gun laws, more school mental health support.
